_comment: Native components Playroom ships that npm can't report: the engine's (credited by its own THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, embedded whole), ExifTool, Electron and the Lensfun data; the AI models are credited from the engine's roster. Read by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs; `license` names a text in build/licenses/.

components.name: PIXL Engine's components
components.use: everything the photo engine ships beside it (pixl_libraw, which is LibRaw 0.22.2 with PIXL's shim; libheif; libde265; libaom; ONNX Runtime) and compiles in (libjpeg-turbo, Little CMS, libwebp, libjxl, Highway, Brotli and its Rust crates). The engine's own notices follow in full, with every licence text they ask for
components.licenseName: each component's own, reproduced in full in the engine's notices below
components.copyright: Copyright (c) their respective authors, as each notice below states
components.source: the source of LibRaw, PIXL's LibRaw shim, libheif and libde265 ships inside the application, beside the engine (app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/@xuckless/pixl-engine-<platform>/); each notice below also names its upstream

components.name: ExifTool
components.use: reads and writes metadata (run as a separate program, through exiftool-vendored)
components.licenseName: the same terms as Perl itself (Artistic License or GNU GPL)

components.name: Electron and Chromium
components.use: the application runtime; Chromium's own notices are in LICENSES.chromium.html beside the application
components.copyright: Copyright (c) Electron contributors. Copyright (c) 2013-2020 GitHub Inc.

components.name: Lensfun database
components.use: Lens profiles (distortion, chromatic aberration, vignetting) and camera crop factors: the bundled lens catalogue, converted by scripts/lensfun-profiles.mjs; updated catalogues are the same data
